skill.name: roblox-ts
skill.description: Write Roblox games in TypeScript. Use for roblox-ts setup, configuration, type-safe Roblox API usage, project structure, package management, compiling TypeScript to Luau, debugging, and working with roblox-ts packages and best practices.

generated_query: I'm building a Roblox game and want to use TypeScript to get type-safe access to Roblox APIs. I need help setting up the project from scratch—creating the directory, initializing the proper configuration files, and installing the required npm packages. After that, I’d like to write a server script that listens for a player joining and sends a welcome message to the client using a RemoteEvent, and a client script that receives it and displays a notification. The RemoteEvent should be strictly typed so the client and server know exactly what data is being passed. Also, I need to set up the build pipeline with watch mode so I can compile to Luau automatically as I edit. Finally, I want a quick sanity check: compile the project and confirm the generated Luau files exist with the correct structure.
